answer: A farm of 174 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are logged in atlas, queued in oasis, and wander publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 54 identities per epoch. A farm of 2849 identities would post 937 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
